own_text: if they have made an application for protection, until five years after the day on which a final determination in respect of the application is made; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: in any other case, until five years after the day on which they become a designated foreign national.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The processing of a request under subsection (1) of a foreign national who, after the request is made, becomes a designated foreign national is suspended

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: if the foreign national has made a claim for refugee protection but has not made an application for protection, until five years after the day on which a final determination in respect of the claim is made;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: if the foreign national has made an application for protection, until five years after the day on which a final determination in respect of the application is made; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: in any other case, until five years after the day on which they become a designated foreign national.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may refuse to consider a request under subsection (1) if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the designated foreign national fails, without reasonable excuse, to comply with any condition imposed on them under subsection 58(4) or section 58.1 or any requirement imposed on them under section 98.1; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: less than 12 months have passed since the end of the applicable period referred to in subsection (1.01) or (1.02).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister is seized of a request referred to in subsection (1) only if the applicable fees in respect of that request have been paid.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may not examine the request if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the foreign national has already made such a request and the request is pending;

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the request is for an exemption from any of the criteria or obligations of Division 0.1;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the foreign national has made a claim for refugee protection that is pending before the Refugee Protection Division or the Refugee Appeal Division;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the foreign national made a claim for refugee protection that was determined to be ineligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division and they made an application for protection to the Minister that is pending; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: subject to subsection (1.21), less than 12 months have passed since

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the day on which the foreign national’s claim for refugee protection was rejected or determined to be withdrawn — after substantive evidence was heard — or abandoned by the Refugee Protection Division, in the case where no appeal was made and no application was made to the Federal Court for leave to commence an application for judicial review, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: in any other case, the latest of

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the day on which the foreign national’s claim for refugee protection was rejected or determined to be withdrawn — after substantive evidence was heard — or abandoned by the Refugee Protection Division or, if there was more than one such rejection or determination, the day on which the last one occurred,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the day on which the foreign national’s claim for refugee protection was rejected or determined to be withdrawn — after substantive evidence was heard — or abandoned by the Refugee Appeal Division or, if there was more than one such rejection or determination, the day on which the last one occurred, and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the day on which the Federal Court refused the foreign national’s application for leave to commence an application for judicial review, or denied their application for judicial review, with respect to their claim for refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: Paragraph (1.2)(c) does not apply in respect of a foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: who, in the case of removal, would be subjected to a risk to their life, caused by the inability of each of their countries of nationality or, if they do not have a country of nationality, their country of former habitual residence, to provide adequate health or medical care; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: whose removal would have an adverse effect on the best interests of a child directly affected.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: In examining the request of a foreign national in Canada, the Minister may not consider the factors that are taken into account in the determination of whether a person is a Convention refugee under section 96 or a person in need of protection under subsection 97(1) but must consider elements related to the hardships that affect the foreign national.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may not grant permanent resident status to a foreign national referred to in subsection 9(1) if the foreign national does not meet the province’s selection criteria applicable to that foreign national.

marginal_note: Humanitarian and compassionate considerations — Minister’s own initiative
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter

marginal_note: Humanitarian and compassionate considerations — Minister’s own initiative
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may, on the Minister’s own initiative, examine the circumstances concerning a foreign national who is inadmissible — other than under section 34, 35, 35.1 or 37 — or who does not meet the requirements of this Act and may grant the foreign national permanent resident status or an exemption from any applicable criteria or obligations of this Act if the Minister is of the opinion that it is justified by humanitarian and compassionate considerations relating to the foreign national, taking into account the best interests of a child directly affected.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may exempt the foreign national from the payment of any applicable fees in respect of the examination of their circumstances under subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may not grant permanent resident status to a foreign national referred to in subsection 9(1) if the foreign national does not meet the province’s selection criteria applicable to that foreign national.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may, in examining the circumstances concerning a foreign national who is inadmissible or who does not meet the requirements of this Act, grant that person permanent resident status or an exemption from any applicable criteria or obligations of this Act if the foreign national complies with any conditions imposed by the Minister and the Minister is of the opinion that it is justified by public policy considerations.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may exempt the foreign national from the payment of any applicable fees in respect of the examination of their circumstances under subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The Minister may not grant permanent resident status to a foreign national referred to in subsection 9(1) if the foreign national does not meet the province’s selection criteria applicable to that foreign national.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The conditions referred to in subsection (1) may include a requirement for the foreign national to obtain an undertaking or to obtain a determination of their eligibility from a third party that meets any criteria specified by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of sections 18 to 25.2, and may include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: entering, remaining in and re-entering Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: permanent resident status or temporary resident status, including acquisition of that status;

label: (b.01)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the circumstances in which an officer may cancel, suspend or vary a visa or other document;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: declarations referred to in subsection 22.1(1);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the circumstances in which all or part of the considerations referred to in section 24 may be taken into account;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: conditions that may or must be imposed, varied or cancelled, individually or by class, on permanent residents and foreign nationals;

label: (d.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: undertakings that may or must be given in respect of requests made under subsection 25(1) or undertakings referred to in subsection 25.2(4), and penalties for failure to comply with undertakings;

label: (d.2)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: the determination of eligibility referred to in subsection 25.2(4); and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: deposits or guarantees of the performance of obligations under this Act that are to be given to the Minister.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status and Authorization to Enter
own_text: The regulations may exempt persons or categories of persons from the application of section 18 and prescribe the conditions under which the exemption applies.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: A permanent resident of Canada has the right to enter and remain in Canada, subject to the provisions of this Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: A permanent resident must comply with any conditions imposed under the regulations or under instructions given under subsection 14.1(1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: A permanent resident must comply with a residency obligation with respect to every five-year period.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: The following provisions govern the residency obligation under subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: a permanent resident complies with the residency obligation with respect to a five-year period if, on each of a total of at least 730 days in that five-year period, they are

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: physically present in Canada,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: outside Canada accompanying a Canadian citizen who is their spouse or common-law partner or, in the case of a child, their parent,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: outside Canada employed on a full-time basis by a Canadian business or in the federal public administration or the public service of a province,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: outside Canada accompanying a permanent resident who is their spouse or common-law partner or, in the case of a child, their parent and who is employed on a full-time basis by a Canadian business or in the federal public administration or the public service of a province, or

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: referred to in regulations providing for other means of compliance;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: it is sufficient for a permanent resident to demonstrate at examination

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: if they have been a permanent resident for less than five years, that they will be able to meet the residency obligation in respect of the five-year period immediately after they became a permanent resident;

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: if they have been a permanent resident for five years or more, that they have met the residency obligation in respect of the five-year period immediately before the examination; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: a determination by an officer that humanitarian and compassionate considerations relating to a permanent resident, taking into account the best interests of a child directly affected by the determination, justify the retention of permanent resident status overcomes any breach of the residency obligation prior to the determination.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: A temporary resident is, subject to the other provisions of this Act, authorized to enter and remain in Canada on a temporary basis as a visitor or as a holder of a temporary resident permit.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: A temporary resident must comply with any conditions imposed under the regulations and with any requirements under this Act, must leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay and may re-enter Canada only if their authorization provides for re-entry.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: In the case of a temporary resident who is authorized to enter and remain in Canada for an extended period in order to visit a Canadian citizen or permanent resident who is their child or grandchild, the period referred to in subsection (2) is five years.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: A foreign national may not work or study in Canada unless authorized to do so under this Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: An officer may, on application, authorize a foreign national to work or study in Canada if the foreign national meets the conditions set out in the regulations.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: Despite subsection (1.1), the officer shall refuse to authorize the foreign national to work in Canada if, in the officer’s opinion, public policy considerations that are specified in the instructions given by the Minister justify such a refusal.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: In applying subsection (1.2), any refusal to give authorization to work in Canada requires the concurrence of a second officer.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: The instructions referred to in subsection (1.2) shall prescribe public policy considerations that aim to protect foreign nationals who are at risk of being subjected to humiliating or degrading treatment, including sexual exploitation.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: An officer may revoke a work permit if, in the officer’s opinion, public policy considerations that are specified in instructions given by the Minister justify the revocation.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: For greater certainty, subsection (1.41) does not affect any other lawful authority to revoke a work permit.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: If, in the view of the Department of Employment and Social Development, public policy considerations that are specified in instructions given by the Minister of Employment and Social Development justify it, that Department may

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: revoke an assessment provided by that Department with respect to an application for a work permit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: suspend the effects of the assessment; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: refuse to process a request for such an assessment.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: For greater certainty, subsection (1.43) does not affect any other lawful authority to revoke an assessment referred to in that subsection.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: Instructions given under this section shall be published in the Canada Gazette .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: The instructions take effect on the day on which they are published, or on any later day specified in the instructions, and apply in respect of all applications for authorization to work in Canada and requests to provide an assessment with respect to an application for a work permit, including those applications and requests that were made before that day and for which a final decision has not been made.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: The instructions cease to have effect on the day on which a notice of revocation is published in the Canada Gazette .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Rights and Obligations of Permanent and Temporary Residents
own_text: Every minor child in Canada, other than a child of a temporary resident not authorized to work or study, is authorized to study at the pre-school, primary or secondary level.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: A permanent resident and a protected person shall be provided with a document indicating their status.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: For the purposes of this Act, unless an officer determines otherwise

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: a person in possession of a status document referred to in subsection (1) is presumed to have the status indicated; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: a person who is outside Canada and who does not present a status document indicating permanent resident status is presumed not to have permanent resident status.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: A permanent resident outside Canada who is not in possession of a status document indicating permanent resident status shall, following an examination, be issued a travel document if an officer is satisfied that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: they comply with the residency obligation under section 28;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: an officer has made the determination referred to in paragraph 28(2)(c); or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Status Document
own_text: they were physically present in Canada at least once within the 365 days before the examination and they have made an appeal under subsection 63(4) that has not been finally determined or the period for making such an appeal has not yet expired.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Refugee Travel Document
own_text: For the purposes of Article 28 of the Refugee Convention, a designated foreign national whose claim for refugee protection or application for protection is accepted is lawfully staying in Canada only if they become a permanent resident or are issued a temporary resident permit under section 24.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of sections 27 to 31, may define, for the purposes of this Act, the terms used in those sections, and may include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: classes of temporary residents, such as students and workers;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: selection criteria for each class of foreign national and for their family members, and the procedures for evaluating all or some of those criteria;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: anything referred to in paragraph (b) for which a decision or recommendation may or must be made by a designated person, institution or organization;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the conditions that must or may be imposed, varied or cancelled, individually or by class, on permanent residents and foreign nationals, including conditions respecting work or study;

label: (d.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the conditions that must or may be imposed, individually or by class, on individuals and entities — including employers and educational institutions — in respect of permanent residents and foreign nationals, or that must or may be varied or cancelled;

label: (d.2)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the power to inspect — including the power to require documents to be provided by individuals and entities, including employers and educational institutions, for inspection — for the purpose of verifying compliance with the conditions imposed under paragraphs (d) and (d.1);

label: (d.3)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the consequences of a failure to comply with the conditions referred to in paragraphs (d) and (d.1);

label: (d.4)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: a system of administrative monetary penalties applicable to the contravention by an employer of any conditions referred to in paragraph (d.1) and the amounts of those penalties;

label: (d.5)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the requirement for an employer to provide a prescribed person with prescribed information in relation to a foreign national’s authorization to work in Canada for the employer;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the residency obligation under section 28, including rules for calculating applicable days and periods; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3 Entering and Remaining in Canada > Regulations
own_text: the circumstances in which a document indicating status or a travel document may or must be issued, renewed or revoked.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3.1 Examination — Foreign Nationals
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3.1 Examination — Foreign Nationals
own_text: A foreign national who is outside Canada and who holds a permanent resident visa, temporary resident visa, electronic travel authorization, temporary resident permit or any other document must, in order to confirm that they meet the requirements of this Act in respect of that document and in the prescribed circumstances, answer truthfully all questions put to them by an officer and must produce a visa and all relevant evidence and documents that the officer reasonably requires.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3.1 Examination — Foreign Nationals
own_text: A foreign national who is outside Canada and who holds a document referred to in subsection (1) must, in order to confirm that they meet the requirements of this Act in respect of that document and in the prescribed circumstances, appear for an examination, including a medical examination, on request of an officer.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3.1 Examination — Foreign Nationals
own_text: For greater certainty, subsections (1) and (2) do not affect any other lawful authority relating to the conduct of an examination of foreign nationals.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 3.1 Examination — Foreign Nationals
own_text: The regulations may prescribe the circumstances in which a foreign national who is outside Canada and who holds a document referred to in subsection 32.1(1) must appear for examination, answer truthfully all questions put to them and produce a visa and all relevant evidence and documents.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: The facts that constitute inadmissibility under sections 34 to 37 include facts arising from omissions and, unless otherwise provided, include facts for which there are reasonable grounds to believe that they have occurred, are occurring or may occur.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A permanent resident or a foreign national is inadmissible on security grounds for

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: engaging in an act of espionage that is against Canada or that is contrary to Canada’s interests;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: engaging in or instigating the subversion by force of any government;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: engaging in an act of subversion against a democratic government, institution or process as they are understood in Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: engaging in terrorism;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: being a danger to the security of Canada;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: engaging in acts of violence that would or might endanger the lives or safety of persons in Canada; or

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: being a member of an organization that there are reasonable grounds to believe engages, has engaged or will engage in acts referred to in paragraph (a), (b), (b.1) or (c).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: [Repealed, 2013, c. 16, s. 13]

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A permanent resident or a foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of violating human or international rights for

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: committing an act outside Canada that constitutes an offence referred to in sections 4 to 7 of the Crimes Against Humanity and War Crimes Act ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: being a prescribed senior official in the service of a government that, in the opinion of the Minister, engages or has engaged in terrorism, systematic or gross human rights violations, or genocide, a war crime or a crime against humanity within the meaning of subsections 6(3) to (5) of the Crimes Against Humanity and War Crimes Act ; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: [Repealed, 2023, c. 19, s. 5]

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: having engaged in conduct that would, in the opinion of the Minister, constitute an offence under section 240.1 of the Criminal Code .

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: [Repealed, 2023, c. 19, s. 5]

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: [Repealed, 2023, c. 19, s. 5]

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: [Repealed, 2023, c. 19, s. 5]

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of sanctions if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: their entry into or stay in Canada is restricted under a decision, resolution or measure of an international organization of states or association of states, of which Canada is a member, that imposes sanctions on a person, entity or foreign state , within the meaning of section 2 of the Special Economic Measures Act , against which or whom Canada has imposed or has agreed to impose sanctions in concert with that organization or association;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: they are currently the subject of an order or regulation made under section 4 of the Special Economic Measures Act ; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: they are currently the subject of an order or regulation made under section 4 of the Justice for Victims of Corrupt Foreign Officials Act (Sergei Magnitsky Law) .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: For greater certainty, despite section 33, a foreign national whose entry into or stay in Canada is no longer restricted under a decision, resolution or measure referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or who ceases being the subject of an order or regulation referred to in paragraph (1)(b) or (c) is no longer inadmissible under that paragraph.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A permanent resident or a foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality for

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: having been convicted in Canada of an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years, or of an offence under an Act of Parliament for which a term of imprisonment of more than six months has been imposed;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: having been convicted of an offence outside Canada that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: committing an act outside Canada that is an offence in the place where it was committed and that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of criminality for

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: having been convicted in Canada of an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by way of indictment, or of two offences under any Act of Parliament not arising out of a single occurrence;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: having been convicted outside Canada of an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament, or of two offences not arising out of a single occurrence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute offences under an Act of Parliament; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: committing an act outside Canada that is an offence in the place where it was committed and that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament.

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: [Repealed, 2023, c. 32, s. 53]

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of transborder criminality for committing, on entering Canada, a prescribed offence under an Act of Parliament.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: The following provisions govern subsections (1) to (2.1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: an offence that may be prosecuted either summarily or by way of indictment is deemed to be an indictable offence, even if it has been prosecuted summarily;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: inadmissibility under subsections (1) to (2.1) may not be based on a conviction in respect of which a record suspension has been ordered and has not been revoked or ceased to have effect under the Criminal Records Act , or in respect of which there has been a final determination of an acquittal;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: the matters referred to in paragraphs (1)(b) and (c) and (2)(b) and (c) do not constitute inadmissibility in respect of a permanent resident or foreign national who, after the prescribed period, satisfies the Minister that they have been rehabilitated or who is a member of a prescribed class that is deemed to have been rehabilitated;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: a determination of whether a permanent resident has committed an act described in paragraph (1)(c) must be based on a balance of probabilities; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: inadmissibility under subsections (1) to (2.1) may not be based on an offence

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act ,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: for which the permanent resident or foreign national is found guilty under the Young Offenders Act , chapter Y-1 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1985, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: for which the permanent resident or foreign national received a youth sentence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A permanent resident or a foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of organized criminality for

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: being a member of an organization that is believed on reasonable grounds to be or to have been engaged in activity that is part of a pattern of criminal activity planned and organized by a number of persons acting in concert in furtherance of the commission of an offence punishable under an Act of Parliament by way of indictment, or in furtherance of the commission of an offence outside Canada that, if committed in Canada, would constitute such an offence, or engaging in activity that is part of such a pattern; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: engaging, in the context of transnational crime, in activities such as people smuggling, trafficking in persons or laundering of money or other proceeds of crime.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: Paragraph (1)(a) does not lead to a determination of inadmissibility by reason only of the fact that the permanent resident or foreign national entered Canada with the assistance of a person who is involved in organized criminal activity.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national is inadmissible on health grounds if their health condition

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: is likely to be a danger to public health;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: is likely to be a danger to public safety; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: might reasonably be expected to cause excessive demand on health or social services.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: Paragraph (1)(c) does not apply in the case of a foreign national who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: has been determined to be a member of the family class and to be the spouse, common-law partner or child of a sponsor within the meaning of the regulations;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: has applied for a permanent resident visa as a Convention refugee or a person in similar circumstances;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: is a protected person; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: is, if prescribed, the spouse, common-law partner, child or other family member of a foreign national referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national is inadmissible for financial reasons if they are or will be unable or unwilling to support themself or any other person who is dependent on them, and have not satisfied an officer that adequate arrangements for care and support, other than those that involve social assistance, have been made.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A permanent resident or a foreign national is inadmissible for misrepresentation

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: for directly or indirectly misrepresenting or withholding material facts relating to a relevant matter that induces or could induce an error in the administration of this Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: for being or having been sponsored by a person who is determined to be inadmissible for misrepresentation;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: on a final determination to vacate a decision to allow their claim for refugee protection or application for protection; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: on ceasing to be a citizen under

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: paragraph 10(1)(a) of the Citizenship Act , as it read immediately before the coming into force of section 8 of the Strengthening Canadian Citizenship Act , in the circumstances set out in subsection 10(2) of the Citizenship Act , as it read immediately before that coming into force,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: subsection 10(1) of the Citizenship Act , in the circumstances set out in section 10.2 of that Act, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: subsection 10.1(3) of the Citizenship Act , in the circumstances set out in section 10.2 of that Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: The following provisions govern subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: the permanent resident or the foreign national continues to be inadmissible for misrepresentation for a period of five years following, in the case of a determination outside Canada, a final determination of inadmissibility under subsection (1) or, in the case of a determination in Canada, the date the removal order is enforced; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: paragraph (1)(b) does not apply unless the Minister is satisfied that the facts of the case justify the inadmissibility.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national who is inadmissible under this section may not apply for permanent resident status during the period referred to in paragraph (2)(a).

marginal_note: Cessation of refugee protection — foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility

marginal_note: Cessation of refugee protection — foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national is inadmissible on a final determination under subsection 108(2) that their refugee protection has ceased.

marginal_note: Cessation of refugee protection — permanent resident
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A permanent resident is inadmissible on a final determination that their refugee protection has ceased for any of the reasons described in paragraphs 108(1)(a) to (d).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A person is inadmissible for failing to comply with this Act

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: in the case of a foreign national, through an act or omission which contravenes, directly or indirectly, a provision of this Act; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: in the case of a permanent resident, through failing to comply with subsection 27(2) or section 28.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: A foreign national, other than a protected person, is inadmissible on grounds of an inadmissible family member if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: their accompanying family member or, in prescribed circumstances, their non-accompanying family member is inadmissible; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: they are an accompanying family member of an inadmissible person.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: In the case of a foreign national referred to in subsection (1) who is a temporary resident or who has made an application for temporary resident status or an application to remain in Canada as a temporary resident,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: the matters referred to in paragraph (1)(a) constitute inadmissibility only if the family member is inadmissible under section 34, 35, 35.1 or 37; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: the matters referred to in paragraph (1)(b) constitute inadmissibility only if the foreign national is an accompanying family member of a person who is inadmissible under section 34, 35, 35.1 or 37.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: The Minister may, on application by a foreign national, declare that the matters referred to in section 34, paragraph 35(1)(b) and subsection 37(1) do not constitute inadmissibility in respect of the foreign national if they satisfy the Minister that it is not contrary to the national interest.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: The Minister may, on the Minister’s own initiative, declare that the matters referred to in section 34, paragraph 35(1)(b) and subsection 37(1) do not constitute inadmissibility in respect of a foreign national if the Minister is satisfied that it is not contrary to the national interest.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: In determining whether to make a declaration, the Minister may only take into account national security and public safety considerations, but, in his or her analysis, is not limited to considering the danger that the foreign national presents to the public or the security of Canada.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 4 Inadmissibility
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this Division, may define, for the purposes of this Act, any of the terms used in this Division, and may include provisions respecting the circumstances in which a class of permanent residents or foreign nationals is exempted from any of the provisions of this Division.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: An officer who is of the opinion that a permanent resident or a foreign national who is in Canada is inadmissible may prepare a report setting out the relevant facts, which report shall be transmitted to the Minister.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: If the Minister is of the opinion that the report is well-founded, the Minister may refer the report to the Immigration Division for an admissibility hearing, except in the case of a permanent resident who is inadmissible solely on the grounds that they have failed to comply with the residency obligation under section 28 and except, in the case of a foreign national, in the prescribed circumstances. In those cases, the Minister may make a removal order.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: An officer or the Immigration Division may impose any conditions, including the payment of a deposit or the posting of a guarantee for compliance with the conditions, that the officer or the Division considers necessary on a permanent resident or a foreign national who is the subject of a report, an admissibility hearing or, being in Canada, a removal order.

marginal_note: Conditions — inadmissibility on grounds of security
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: If a report on inadmissibility on grounds of security is referred to the Immigration Division and the permanent resident or the foreign national who is the subject of the report is not detained, an officer shall also impose the prescribed conditions on the person.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: The prescribed conditions imposed under subsection (4) cease to apply only when

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: the person is detained;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: the report on inadmissibility on grounds of security is withdrawn;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: a final determination is made not to make a removal order against the person for inadmissibility on grounds of security;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: the Minister makes a declaration under subsection 42.1(1) or (2) in relation to the person; or

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Report on Inadmissibility
own_text: a removal order is enforced against the person in accordance with the regulations.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Admissibility Hearing by the Immigration Division
own_text: The Immigration Division must not hold an admissibility hearing if the permanent resident or foreign national who is the subject of the hearing is not physically present in Canada.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Admissibility Hearing by the Immigration Division
own_text: The Immigration Division, at the conclusion of an admissibility hearing, shall make one of the following decisions:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Admissibility Hearing by the Immigration Division
own_text: recognize the right to enter Canada of a Canadian citizen within the meaning of the Citizenship Act , a person registered as an Indian under the Indian Act or a permanent resident;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Admissibility Hearing by the Immigration Division
own_text: grant permanent resident status or temporary resident status to a foreign national if it is satisfied that the foreign national meets the requirements of this Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Admissibility Hearing by the Immigration Division
own_text: authorize a permanent resident or a foreign national, with or without conditions, to enter Canada for further examination; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Admissibility Hearing by the Immigration Division
own_text: make the applicable removal order against a foreign national who has not been authorized to enter Canada, if it is not satisfied that the foreign national is not inadmissible, or against a foreign national who has been authorized to enter Canada or a permanent resident, if it is satisfied that the foreign national or the permanent resident is inadmissible.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: A person loses permanent resident status

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: when they become a Canadian citizen;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: on a final determination of a decision made outside of Canada that they have failed to comply with the residency obligation under section 28;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: when a removal order made against them comes into force;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: on a final determination under subsection 108(2) that their refugee protection has ceased for any of the reasons described in paragraphs 108(1)(a) to (d);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: on a final determination under section 109 to vacate a decision to allow their claim for refugee protection or a final determination to vacate a decision to allow their application for protection; or

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: on approval by an officer of their application to renounce their permanent resident status.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: A person who loses their permanent resident status under paragraph (1)(e) becomes a temporary resident for a period of six months unless they make their application to renounce their permanent resident status at a port of entry or are not physically present in Canada on the day on which their application is approved.

marginal_note: Effect of ceasing to be citizen
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: A person becomes a permanent resident if he or she ceases to be a citizen under

label: (a)
marginal_note: Effect of ceasing to be citizen
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: paragraph 10(1)(a) of the Citizenship Act , as it read immediately before the coming into force of section 8 of the Strengthening Canadian Citizenship Act , other than in the circumstances set out in subsection 10(2) of the Citizenship Act , as it read immediately before that coming into force;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Effect of ceasing to be citizen
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: subsection 10(1) of the Citizenship Act , other than in the circumstances set out in section 10.2 of that Act; or

label: (c)
marginal_note: Effect of ceasing to be citizen
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: subsection 10.1(3) of the Citizenship Act , other than in the circumstances set out in section 10.2 of that Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: A foreign national loses temporary resident status

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: at the end of the period for which they are authorized to remain in Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: on a determination by an officer or the Immigration Division that they have failed to comply with any other requirement of this Act; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Loss of Status
own_text: on cancellation of their temporary resident permit, other than cancellation by an order made under subsection 87.302(1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order is enforceable if it has come into force and is not stayed.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If a removal order is enforceable, the foreign national against whom it was made must leave Canada immediately and the order must be enforced as soon as possible.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order comes into force on

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the day on which it is made, if there is no right to appeal;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the day after the day on which the appeal period expires, if there is a right to appeal and no appeal is made; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the day on which a final determination is made that has the effect of confirming the removal order, if an appeal is made.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: Despite subsection (1), a removal order made with respect to a refugee protection claimant is conditional and comes into force

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: on the day on which notice is provided that the claim has been determined to be ineligible only under paragraph 101(1)(e);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: seven days after the day on which notice is provided that the claim has otherwise been determined to be ineligible under subsection 101(1);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: if the claim is rejected by the Refugee Protection Division and there is no right to appeal, 15 days after the day on which notice of the rejection is provided;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: if the claim is rejected by the Refugee Protection Division and the claimant does not file and perfect an appeal within the applicable time limits, on the later of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the day after the day on which the applicable time limit expires, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: 15 days after the day on which notice of the rejection is provided;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: 15 days after the day on which the Refugee Appeal Division provides notice that the claim is rejected;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: on the day on which notice is provided that the claim has been determined to be withdrawn;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: 15 days after the day on which notice is provided that the claim has been determined to be abandoned; or

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: 15 days after the day on which proceedings are terminated as a result of a notice given under paragraph 104(1)(c) or (d).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: The Minister must prepare a report in respect of each month of the year that sets out the number of removal orders that were enforced in that month, the number of removal orders that were not enforced in accordance with subsection (3) and the reasons for the delays.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: The report must also include countries of origin, age and gender breakdowns and criminal backgrounds of persons removed.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: The report must be tabled in each House of Parliament within 10 days after the last day of the month to which the report relates or, if a House is not then sitting, on any of the first 10 days on which that House is sitting after that day.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order is stayed

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: if a decision that was made in a judicial proceeding — at which the Minister shall be given the opportunity to make submissions — would be directly contravened by the enforcement of the removal order;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: in the case of a foreign national sentenced to a term of imprisonment in Canada, until the sentence is completed;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: for the duration of a stay imposed by the Immigration Appeal Division or any other court of competent jurisdiction;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: for the duration of a stay under paragraph 114(1)(b); and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: for the duration of a stay imposed by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order that has not been enforced becomes void if the foreign national becomes a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If a removal order has been enforced, the foreign national shall not return to Canada, unless authorized by an officer or in other prescribed circumstances.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If a removal order for which there is no right of appeal has been enforced and is subsequently set aside in a judicial review, the foreign national is entitled to return to Canada at the expense of the Minister.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this Division, and may include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: conditions that may or must be imposed, varied, or cancelled, individually or by class, on permanent residents and foreign nationals;

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the form and manner in which an application to renounce permanent resident status must be made and the conditions that must be met before such an application may be approved;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the circumstances in which a removal order shall be made or confirmed against a permanent resident or a foreign national;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the circumstances in which status may be restored;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the circumstances in which a removal order may be stayed, including a stay imposed by the Minister and a stay that is not expressly provided for by this Act;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the effect and enforcement of removal orders, including the consideration of factors in the determination of when enforcement is possible;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the effect of a record suspension under the Criminal Records Act on the status of permanent residents and foreign nationals and removal orders made against them; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 5 Loss of Status and Removal > Regulations
own_text: the financial obligations that may be imposed with respect to a removal order.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: The Immigration Division is the competent Division of the Board with respect to the review of reasons for detention under this Division.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: An officer may issue a warrant for the arrest and detention of a permanent resident or a foreign national who the officer has reasonable grounds to believe is inadmissible and is a danger to the public or is unlikely to appear for examination, for an admissibility hearing, for removal from Canada or at a proceeding that could lead to the making of a removal order by the Minister under subsection 44(2).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: An officer may, without a warrant, arrest and detain a foreign national, other than a protected person,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: who the officer has reasonable grounds to believe is inadmissible and is a danger to the public or is unlikely to appear for examination, an admissibility hearing, removal from Canada, or at a proceeding that could lead to the making of a removal order by the Minister under subsection 44(2); or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: if the officer is not satisfied of the identity of the foreign national in the course of any procedure under this Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: A permanent resident or a foreign national may, on entry into Canada, be detained if an officer

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: considers it necessary to do so in order for the examination to be completed; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: has reasonable grounds to suspect that the permanent resident or the foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of security, violating human or international rights, sanctions, serious criminality, criminality, transborder criminality or organized criminality.

marginal_note: Mandatory arrest and detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: If a designation is made under subsection 20.1(1), an officer must

label: (a)
marginal_note: Mandatory arrest and detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: detain, on their entry into Canada, a foreign national who, as a result of the designation, is a designated foreign national and who is 16 years of age or older on the day of the arrival that is the subject of the designation; or

label: (b)
marginal_note: Mandatory arrest and detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: arrest and detain without a warrant — or issue a warrant for the arrest and detention of — a foreign national who, after their entry into Canada, becomes a designated foreign national as a result of the designation and who was 16 years of age or older on the day of the arrival that is the subject of the designation.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: If a permanent resident or a foreign national is taken into detention, an officer shall without delay give notice to the Immigration Division.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: An officer may order the release from detention of a permanent resident or a foreign national before the first detention review by the Immigration Division if the officer is of the opinion that the reasons for the detention no longer exist. The officer may impose any conditions, including the payment of a deposit or the posting of a guarantee for compliance with the conditions, that the officer considers necessary.

marginal_note: Period of detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: Despite subsection (1), a designated foreign national who is detained under this Division and who was 16 years of age or older on the day of the arrival that is the subject of the designation in question must be detained until

label: (a)
marginal_note: Period of detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: a final determination is made to allow their claim for refugee protection or application for protection;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Period of detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: they are released as a result of the Immigration Division ordering their release under section 58; or

label: (c)
marginal_note: Period of detention — designated foreign national
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: they are released as a result of the Minister ordering their release under section 58.1.

marginal_note: Conditions — inadmissibility on grounds of security
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: If an officer orders the release of a permanent resident or foreign national who is the subject of either a report on inadmissibility on grounds of security that is referred to the Immigration Division or a removal order for inadmissibility on grounds of security, the officer must also impose the prescribed conditions on the person.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: The prescribed conditions imposed under subsection (3) cease to apply only when one of the events described in paragraphs 44 (5)(a) to (e) occurs.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 6 Detention and Release
own_text: Within 48 hours after a permanent resident or a foreign national is taken into detention, or without delay afterward, the Immigration Division must review the reasons for the continued detention.
