own_text: applications for temporary resident visas, work permits or study permits, or any combination of those types of applications, made by any citizen or national of that foreign state or territory are not to be accepted for processing if they are received during the period or periods set out in the order or, if a period is not set out, during the period that the order is in force;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: the processing of any of those types of applications, or any combination of them, made by any citizen or national of that foreign state or territory that are pending on the coming into force of the order or, if amended, the amendment, is to be suspended during the period or periods set out in the order or, if a period is not set out, during the period that the order is in force; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: the processing of any of those types of applications, or any combination of them, made by any citizen or national of that foreign state or territory that are pending on the coming into force of the order or, if amended, the amendment, is to be terminated.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: An order made under subsection (1) may

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: restrict the application of the order to applications, citizens or nationals within a class of applications, citizens or nationals that is specified in the order;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: provide for the retention, return or other disposition of applications;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: if the processing of applications is terminated, provide for the repayment of fees paid in respect of those applications; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: provide for any other matter arising out of or ancillary to the exercise of the power conferred under that subsection.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Applications for Temporary Resident Visas, Work Permits and Study Permits
own_text: The fact that an application is retained, returned or otherwise disposed of does not constitute a decision not to issue the visa or permit in relation to which the application is made.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Skilled Workers
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Skilled Workers
own_text: An application by a foreign national for a permanent resident visa as a member of the prescribed class of federal skilled workers that was made before February 27, 2008 is terminated if, before March 29, 2012, it has not been established by an officer, in accordance with the regulations, whether the applicant meets the selection criteria and other requirements applicable to that class.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Skilled Workers
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to an application in respect of which a superior court has made a final determination unless the determination is made on or after March 29, 2012.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Skilled Workers
own_text: The fact that an application is terminated under subsection (1) does not constitute a decision not to issue a permanent resident visa.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Skilled Workers
own_text: Any fees paid to the Minister in respect of the application referred to in subsection (1) — including for the acquisition of permanent resident status — must be returned, without interest, to the person who paid them. The amounts payable may be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Skilled Workers
own_text: No person has a right of recourse or indemnity against Her Majesty in connection with an application that is terminated under subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: An application by a foreign national for a permanent resident visa as a member of the prescribed class of investors or of entrepreneurs is terminated if, before February 11, 2014, it has not been established by an officer, in accordance with the regulations, whether the applicant meets the selection criteria and other requirements applicable to the class in question.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: an application in respect of which a superior court has made a final determination unless the determination is made on or after February 11, 2014; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: an application made by an investor or entrepreneur who is selected as such by a province whose government has entered into an agreement referred to in subsection 9(1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: The fact that an application is terminated under subsection (1) does not constitute a decision not to issue a permanent resident visa.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: Any fees paid to the Minister in respect of the application referred to in subsection (1) — including for the acquisition of permanent resident status — must be returned, without interest, to the person who paid them. The amounts payable may be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: If an application for a permanent resident visa as a member of the prescribed class of investors is terminated under subsection (1), an amount equal to the investment made by the applicant in respect of their application must be returned, without interest, to the applicant. The amount may be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: If the provincial allocation of an investment made in respect of an application for a permanent resident visa as a member of the prescribed class of investors that is terminated under subsection (1) has been transferred to an approved fund, as defined in subsection 88(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations , the province whose government controls the approved fund must return an amount equal to that provincial allocation to the Minister without delay. The return of the amount extinguishes the debt obligation in respect of that provincial allocation.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Federal Investor and Entrepreneur Classes
own_text: No right of recourse or indemnity lies against Her Majesty in right of Canada in connection with an application that is terminated under subsection (1), including in respect of any contract or other arrangement relating to any aspect of the application.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Loans
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Loans
own_text: The Minister of Finance may, from time to time, advance to the Minister out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund, up to the maximum amount that is prescribed, sums that the Minister may require in order to make loans for the purposes of this Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Loans
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this section, and may include provisions respecting classes of persons to whom, and the purposes for which, the loans may be made.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The regulations may govern fees for services provided in the administration of this Act, and cases in which fees may be waived by the Minister or otherwise, individually or by class.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to a fee for the provision of services in relation to a request for an assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development with respect to an application for a work permit.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to a fee for the provision of services in relation to the processing of an application

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: for a temporary resident visa or permanent resident visa;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: for a work permit or study permit;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: for an extension of an authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: to remain in Canada as a permanent resident;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: to sponsor a foreign national as a member of the family class;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: to make the request referred to in subsection 25(1);

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: for a travel document issued under subsection 31(3); and

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: for a permanent resident card.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to a fee for the provision of services in relation to an application referred to in subsection 11(1.01).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to a fee for the provision of services in relation to the collection, use and disclosure of biometric information and for the provision of related services.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to a fee for the examination of the circumstances of a foreign national under subsection 25.2(1).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The regulations may

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: govern fees to be paid for rights and privileges conferred by means of a work permit; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: waive the fees referred to in paragraph (a) for certain work permits or certain classes of work permits.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to fees referred to in paragraph (1)(a).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to fees for the acquisition of permanent resident status.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The regulations may

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: govern fees to be paid in respect of the compliance regime that applies to employers in relation to their employment of foreign nationals whose authorizations to work in Canada do not require an assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: govern cases in which the fees referred to in paragraph (a) are waived.

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Fees
own_text: The Service Fees Act does not apply to fees referred to in paragraph (1)(a).

marginal_note: Minister directs special numbers to be issued
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Social Insurance Numbers
own_text: The Minister may direct the Canada Employment Insurance Commission to assign to persons, other than Canadian citizens or permanent residents, Social Insurance Numbers identifying those persons as persons who may be required under this Act to obtain authorization to work in Canada.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: Subject to this section, no person shall knowingly, directly or indirectly, represent or advise a person for consideration — or offer to do so — in connection with the submission of an expression of interest under subsection 10.1(3) or a proceeding or application under this Act.

marginal_note: Persons who may represent or advise
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: A person does not contravene subsection (1) if they are

label: (a)
marginal_note: Persons who may represent or advise
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: a lawyer who is a member in good standing of a law society of a province or a notary who is a member in good standing of the Chambre des notaires du Québec ;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Persons who may represent or advise
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: any other member in good standing of a law society of a province or the Chambre des notaires du Québec , including a paralegal; or

label: (c)
marginal_note: Persons who may represent or advise
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: a member in good standing of the College , as defined in section 2 of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants Act .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: A student-at-law does not contravene subsection (1) by offering or providing representation or advice to a person if the student-at-law is acting under the supervision of a person mentioned in paragraph (2)(a) who is representing or advising the person — or offering to do so — in connection with the submission of an expression of interest under subsection 10.1(3) or a proceeding or application under this Act.

marginal_note: Agreement or arrangement with Her Majesty
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: An entity, including a person acting on its behalf, that offers or provides services to assist persons in connection with the submission of an expression of interest under subsection 10.1(3) or an application under this Act, including for a permanent or temporary resident visa, travel documents or a work or study permit, does not contravene subsection (1) if it is acting in accordance with an agreement or arrangement between that entity and Her Majesty in right of Canada that authorizes it to provide those services.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: For greater certainty, the Québec Immigration Act , CQLR, c. I-0.2.1, applies to, among other persons, every person who, in Quebec, represents or advises a person for consideration — or offers to do so — in connection with a proceeding or application under this Act and is a member of the College , as defined in section 2 of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants Act .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: Every person who contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $200,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than two years, or to both; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $40,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than six months, or to both.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: For greater certainty, in this section, proceeding does not include a proceeding before a superior court.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: The regulations may

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: establish a system of administrative penalties and consequences — including of administrative monetary penalties — applicable to the violations designated in regulations made under paragraph (b) and set the amounts of those administrative monetary penalties;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: designate as a violation the contravention — including a contravention committed outside Canada — of any specified provision of this Act or of the regulations by any person who, directly or indirectly, represents or advises a person for consideration — or offers to do so — in connection with the submission of an expression of interest under subsection 10.1(3) or a proceeding or application under this Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: prohibit acts in relation to the activity of representing or advising — or offering to do so — described in paragraph (b); and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: provide for the power to inspect — including the power to require documents to be provided by individuals and entities for inspection — for the purpose of verifying compliance with the provisions specified in regulations made under paragraph (b).

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: Any regulation made under paragraph (1)(a) must provide that a person who is the subject of a notice of violation has the right to request, from a person appointed under subsection (3), a review of the notice or of the penalty imposed.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: The Governor in Council may, by order, appoint one or more Canadian citizens or permanent residents to conduct reviews in respect of notices of violation issued, or penalties imposed, under a regulation made under paragraph (1)(a) and to perform any other function conferred on them by a regulation made under that paragraph.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Representation or Advice
own_text: A person appointed by order under subsection (3) holds office during good behaviour for a term that the Governor in Council may specify, by order, but may be removed for cause by the Governor in Council at any time.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: A regulation may incorporate by reference the following material:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: material produced by a person or body other than the Governor in Council;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: material referred to in paragraph (a) that has been subsequently adapted or edited in order to facilitate its incorporation for the purposes of the regulation;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: material that has been developed jointly with another government or government agency for the purpose of harmonizing the regulation with other laws; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: material that is technical or explanatory in nature, such as specifications, classifications, illustrations or graphs, as well as examples that may assist in the application of the regulation.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: An instruction given by the Minister or the Minister of Employment and Social Development under this Act may incorporate by reference any material, regardless of its source.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: Material may be incorporated by reference on a specified date or as amended from time to time.

marginal_note: Incorporated material is not a regulation
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: For greater certainty, material that is incorporated by reference in a regulation made under this Act is not a regulation for the purposes of the Statutory Instruments Act .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Material Incorporated in Regulations
own_text: Instructions given by the Minister or the Minister of Employment and Social Development under this Act and guidelines issued by the Chairperson under paragraph 159(1)(h) are not statutory instruments for the purposes of the Statutory Instruments Act .

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: The Minister must, on or before November 1 of each year or, if a House of Parliament is not then sitting, within the next 30 days on which that House is sitting after that date, table in each House of Parliament a report on the operation of this Act in the preceding calendar year.

heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: The report shall include a description of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: the instructions given under section 87.3 and other activities and initiatives taken concerning the selection of foreign nationals, including measures taken in cooperation with the provinces;

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: any instructions given under paragraph 10.3(1)(h.2) that establish a category of eligible foreign nationals, the economic goal sought to be supported in establishing the category and the number of foreign nationals invited to make an application for permanent residence in respect of the category;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: in respect of Canada, the number of foreign nationals who became permanent residents, and the number projected to become permanent residents in the following year;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: in respect of Canada, the linguistic profile of foreign nationals who became permanent residents;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: in respect of each province that has entered into a federal-provincial agreement described in subsection 9(1), the number, for each class listed in the agreement, of persons that became permanent residents and that the province projects will become permanent residents there in the following year;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: the number of temporary resident permits issued under section 24, categorized according to grounds of inadmissibility, if any;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: the number of persons granted permanent resident status under each of subsections 25(1), 25.1(1) and 25.2(1);

label: (e.1)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: any instructions given under subsection 30(1.2), (1.41) or (1.43) during the year in question and the date of their publication; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 1 Immigration to Canada > DIVISION 10 General Provisions > Report to Parliament
own_text: a gender-based analysis of the impact of this Act.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: Refugee protection is conferred on a person when

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: the person has been determined to be a Convention refugee or a person in similar circumstances under a visa application and becomes a permanent resident under the visa or a temporary resident under a temporary resident permit for protection reasons;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: the Board determines the person to be a Convention refugee or a person in need of protection; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: except in the case of a person described in subsection 112(3), the Minister allows an application for protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A protected person is a person on whom refugee protection is conferred under subsection (1), and whose claim or application has not subsequently been deemed to be rejected under subsection 108(3), 109(3) or 114(4).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A Convention refugee is a person who, by reason of a well-founded fear of persecution for reasons of race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group or political opinion,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: is outside each of their countries of nationality and is unable or, by reason of that fear, unwilling to avail themself of the protection of each of those countries; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: not having a country of nationality, is outside the country of their former habitual residence and is unable or, by reason of that fear, unwilling to return to that country.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A person in need of protection is a person in Canada whose removal to their country or countries of nationality or, if they do not have a country of nationality, their country of former habitual residence, would subject them personally

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: to a danger, believed on substantial grounds to exist, of torture within the meaning of Article 1 of the Convention Against Torture; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: to a risk to their life or to a risk of cruel and unusual treatment or punishment if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: the person is unable or, because of that risk, unwilling to avail themself of the protection of that country,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: the risk would be faced by the person in every part of that country and is not faced generally by other individuals in or from that country,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: the risk is not inherent or incidental to lawful sanctions, unless imposed in disregard of accepted international standards, and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: the risk is not caused by the inability of that country to provide adequate health or medical care.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A person in Canada who is a member of a class of persons that is prescribed as being in need of protection is also a person in need of protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A person referred to in section E or F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention is not a Convention refugee or a person in need of protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A designated foreign national on whom refugee protection is conferred under paragraph 95(1)(b) or (c) must report to an officer in accordance with the regulations.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: A designated foreign national who is required to report to an officer must answer truthfully all questions put to him or her and must provide any information and documents that the officer requests.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 1 Refugee Protection, Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of section 98.1 and may include provisions respecting the requirement to report to an officer.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claim for Refugee Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: A claim for refugee protection may be made in or outside Canada.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: A claim for refugee protection made by a person outside Canada must be made by making an application for a visa as a Convention refugee or a person in similar circumstances, and is governed by Part 1.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: A claim for refugee protection made by a person inside Canada must be made in person to an officer, must not be made by a person who is subject to a removal order, and is governed by this Part.

marginal_note: Claim made inside Canada — not at port of entry
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: A person who makes a claim for refugee protection inside Canada other than at a port of entry must provide the officer, within the time limits provided for in the regulations, with the documents and information — including in respect of the basis for the claim — required by the rules of the Board, in accordance with those rules.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: An application to become a permanent resident made by a protected person is governed by Part 1.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: An officer shall, after receipt of a claim referred to in subsection 99(3), determine whether the claim is eligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division and, if it is eligible, shall refer the claim in accordance with the rules of the Board.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The burden of proving that a claim is eligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division rests on the claimant, who must answer truthfully all questions put to them.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The officer shall suspend consideration of the eligibility of the person’s claim if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: a report has been referred for a determination, at an admissibility hearing, of whether the person is inadmissible on grounds of security, violating human or international rights, serious criminality or organized criminality; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the officer considers it necessary to wait for a decision of a court with respect to a claimant who is charged with an offence under an Act of Parliament that is punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division may not consider a claim until it is referred by the officer.

marginal_note: Documents and information to be provided
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: A person who makes a claim for refugee protection inside Canada at a port of entry and whose claim is referred to the Refugee Protection Division must provide the Division, within the time limits provided for in the regulations, with the documents and information — including in respect of the basis for the claim — required by the rules of the Board, in accordance with those rules.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The referring officer must, in accordance with the regulations, the rules of the Board and any directions of the Chairperson of the Board, fix the date on which the claimant is to attend a hearing before the Refugee Protection Division.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: If a traveller is detained or isolated under the Quarantine Act , the period referred to in subsections (1) and (3) does not begin to run until the day on which the detention or isolation ends.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: A claim is ineligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: refugee protection has been conferred on the claimant under this Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: a claim for refugee protection by the claimant has been rejected by the Board;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the claimant entered Canada after June 24, 2020 and made the claim more than one year after the day of their entry;

label: (b.2)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the claimant entered Canada at a location along the Canada–United States land border — including the waters along or across that border — that is not a port of entry and made the claim after the end of the time limit referred to in subsection 159.4(1.1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations ;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: a prior claim by the claimant was determined to be ineligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division, or to have been withdrawn or abandoned;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the claimant has, before making a claim for refugee protection in Canada, made a claim for refugee protection to a country other than Canada, and the fact of its having been made has been confirmed in accordance with an agreement or arrangement entered into by Canada and that country for the purpose of facilitating information sharing to assist in the administration and enforcement of their immigration and citizenship laws;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the claimant has been recognized as a Convention refugee by a country other than Canada and can be sent or returned to that country;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the claimant came directly or indirectly to Canada from a country designated by the regulations, other than a country of their nationality or their former habitual residence; or

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: the claimant has been determined to be inadmissible on grounds of security, violating human or international rights, serious criminality or organized criminality.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b.1), if the claimant has entered Canada more than once after June 24, 2020, the one-year period referred to in that paragraph begins on the day after the day of their first entry.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: If a claim is determined to be ineligible under subsection 101(1), the officer shall terminate the processing of the claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: A claim is not ineligible by reason of serious criminality under paragraph (1)(f) unless

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: in the case of inadmissibility by reason of a conviction in Canada, the conviction is for an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: in the case of inadmissibility by reason of a conviction outside Canada, the conviction is for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The regulations may govern matters relating to the application of sections 100 and 101, may, for the purposes of this Act, define the terms used in those sections and, for the purpose of sharing responsibility with governments of foreign states for the consideration of refugee claims, may include provisions

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: designating countries that comply with Article 33 of the Refugee Convention and Article 3 of the Convention Against Torture;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: making a list of those countries and amending it as necessary; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: respecting the circumstances and criteria for the application of paragraph 101(1)(e).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The following factors are to be considered in designating a country under paragraph (1)(a):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: whether the country is a party to the Refugee Convention and to the Convention Against Torture;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: its policies and practices with respect to claims under the Refugee Convention and with respect to obligations under the Convention Against Torture;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: its human rights record; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: whether it is party to an agreement with the Government of Canada for the purpose of sharing responsibility with respect to claims for refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Examination of Eligibility to Refer Claim
own_text: The Governor in Council must ensure the continuing review of factors set out in subsection (2) with respect to each designated country.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: Proceedings of the Refugee Protection Division in respect of a claim for refugee protection are suspended on notice by an officer that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: the matter has been referred to the Immigration Division to determine whether the claimant is inadmissible on grounds of security, violating human or international rights, serious criminality or organized criminality; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: an officer considers it necessary to wait for a decision of a court with respect to a claimant who is charged with an offence under an Act of Parliament that may be punished by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: On notice by an officer that the suspended claim was determined to be eligible, proceedings of the Refugee Protection Division must continue.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: An officer may, with respect to a claim that is before the Refugee Protection Division or, in the case of paragraph (a.1) or (d), that is before or has been determined by the Refugee Protection Division or the Refugee Appeal Division, give notice that an officer has determined that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: the claim is ineligible under paragraphs 101(1)(a) to (e), other than paragraph 101(1)(c.1);

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: the claim is ineligible under paragraph 101(1)(c.1);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: the claim is ineligible under paragraph 101(1)(f);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: the claim was referred as a result of the direct or indirect misrepresentation or withholding of material facts relating to a relevant matter and was not otherwise eligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: the claim is not the first claim that was received by an officer in respect of the claimant.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: A notice given under the following provisions has the following effects:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: if given under paragraph (1)(a), (b) or (c), it terminates pending proceedings in the Refugee Protection Division respecting the claim;

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: if given under paragraph (1)(a.1), it terminates pending proceedings in the Refugee Protection Division or, in the case of an appeal made by the claimant, the Refugee Appeal Division, respecting the claim; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: if given under paragraph (1)(d), it terminates proceedings in and nullifies any decision of the Refugee Protection Division or the Refugee Appeal Division respecting a claim other than the first claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 107(1), if a person making a claim for refugee protection is not physically present in Canada, the Refugee Protection Division

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: in the case where the person has voluntarily returned to the country in respect of which they claimed refugee protection and the Refugee Protection Division has not yet made a decision in respect of the claim, must determine that the claim has been abandoned; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: in any other case, must not commence, or must suspend, consideration of the claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: If a person who is the subject of an appeal is not physically present in Canada, the Refugee Appeal Division

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: in the case where the person has made the appeal and has voluntarily returned to the country in respect of which they claimed refugee protection and the Refugee Appeal Division has not yet made a decision in respect of the appeal, must determine that the appeal has been abandoned; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Suspension or Termination of Consideration of Claim
own_text: in any other case, must not commence, or must suspend, consideration of the appeal, other than an appeal by the Minister.

marginal_note: Suspension if proceeding under Extradition Act
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Extradition Procedure

marginal_note: Suspension if proceeding under Extradition Act
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Extradition Procedure
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division and Refugee Appeal Division shall not commence, or shall suspend, consideration of any matter concerning a person against whom an authority to proceed has been issued under section 15 of the Extradition Act with respect to an offence under Canadian law that is punishable under an Act of Parliament by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years, until a final decision under the Extradition Act with respect to the discharge or surrender of the person has been made.

marginal_note: Continuation if discharge under Extradition Act
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Extradition Procedure
own_text: If the person is finally discharged under the Extradition Act , the proceedings of the applicable Division may be commenced or continued as though there had not been any proceedings under that Act.

marginal_note: Rejection if surrender under Extradition Act
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Extradition Procedure
own_text: If the person is ordered surrendered by the Minister of Justice under the Extradition Act and the offence for which the person was committed by the judge under section 29 of that Act is punishable under an Act of Parliament by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years, the order of surrender is deemed to be a rejection of a claim for refugee protection based on paragraph (b) of Section F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Extradition Procedure
own_text: The deemed rejection referred to in subsection (3) may not be appealed, and is not subject to judicial review except to the extent that a judicial review of the order of surrender is provided for under the Extradition Act .

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Extradition Procedure
own_text: If the person has not made a claim for refugee protection before the order of surrender referred to in subsection (3), the person may not do so before the surrender.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Claimant Without Identification
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division must take into account, with respect to the credibility of a claimant, whether the claimant possesses acceptable documentation establishing identity, and if not, whether they have provided a reasonable explanation for the lack of documentation or have taken reasonable steps to obtain the documentation.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Decision on Claim for Refugee Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Decision on Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division shall accept a claim for refugee protection if it determines that the claimant is a Convention refugee or person in need of protection, and shall otherwise reject the claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Decision on Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: If the Refugee Protection Division is of the opinion, in rejecting a claim, that there was no credible or trustworthy evidence on which it could have made a favourable decision, it shall state in its reasons for the decision that there is no credible basis for the claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Decision on Claim for Refugee Protection
own_text: If the Refugee Protection Division rejects a claim for refugee protection, it must state in its reasons for the decision that the claim is manifestly unfounded if it is of the opinion that the claim is clearly fraudulent.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: A claim for refugee protection shall be rejected, and a person is not a Convention refugee or a person in need of protection, in any of the following circumstances:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: the person has voluntarily reavailed themself of the protection of their country of nationality;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: the person has voluntarily reacquired their nationality;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: the person has acquired a new nationality and enjoys the protection of the country of that new nationality;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: the person has voluntarily become re-established in the country that the person left or remained outside of and in respect of which the person claimed refugee protection in Canada; or

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: the reasons for which the person sought refugee protection have ceased to exist.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: On application by the Minister, the Refugee Protection Division may determine that refugee protection referred to in subsection 95(1) has ceased for any of the reasons described in subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: If the application is allowed, the claim of the person is deemed to be rejected.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Cessation of Refugee Protection
own_text: Paragraph (1)(e) does not apply to a person who establishes that there are compelling reasons arising out of previous persecution, torture, treatment or punishment for refusing to avail themselves of the protection of the country which they left, or outside of which they remained, due to such previous persecution, torture, treatment or punishment.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Applications to Vacate
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Applications to Vacate
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division may, on application by the Minister, vacate a decision to allow a claim for refugee protection, if it finds that the decision was obtained as a result of directly or indirectly misrepresenting or withholding material facts relating to a relevant matter.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Applications to Vacate
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division may reject the application if it is satisfied that other sufficient evidence was considered at the time of the first determination to justify refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Applications to Vacate
own_text: If the application is allowed, the claim of the person is deemed to be rejected and the decision that led to the conferral of refugee protection is nullified.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: The Minister may, by order, designate a country, for the purposes of subsection 110(2) and section 111.1.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: The Minister may only make a designation

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: in the case where the number of claims for refugee protection made in Canada by nationals of the country in question in respect of which the Refugee Protection Division has made a final determination is equal to or greater than the number provided for by order of the Minister,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: if the rate, expressed as a percentage, that is obtained by dividing the total number of claims made by nationals of the country in question that, in a final determination by the Division during the period provided for in the order, are rejected or determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the total number of claims made by nationals of the country in question in respect of which the Division has, during the same period, made a final determination is equal to or greater than the percentage provided for in the order, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: if the rate, expressed as a percentage, that is obtained by dividing the total number of claims made by nationals of the country in question that, in a final determination by the Division, during the period provided for in the order, are determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the total number of claims made by nationals of the country in question in respect of which the Division has, during the same period, made a final determination is equal to or greater than the percentage provided for in the order; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: in the case where the number of claims for refugee protection made in Canada by nationals of the country in question in respect of which the Refugee Protection Division has made a final determination is less than the number provided for by order of the Minister, if the Minister is of the opinion that in the country in question

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: there is an independent judicial system,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: basic democratic rights and freedoms are recognized and mechanisms for redress are available if those rights or freedoms are infringed, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: civil society organizations exist.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: The Minister may, by order, provide for the number, period or percentages referred to in subsection (2).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Designated Countries of Origin
own_text: An order made under subsection (1) or (3) is not a statutory instrument for the purposes of the Statutory Instruments Act . However, it must be published in the Canada Gazette .

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: Subject to subsections (1.1) and (2), a person or the Minister may appeal, in accordance with the rules of the Board, on a question of law, of fact or of mixed law and fact, to the Refugee Appeal Division against a decision of the Refugee Protection Division to allow or reject the person’s claim for refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: The Minister may satisfy any requirement respecting the manner in which an appeal is filed and perfected by submitting a notice of appeal and any supporting documents.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: No appeal may be made in respect of any of the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: a decision of the Refugee Protection Division allowing or rejecting the claim for refugee protection of a designated foreign national;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: a determination that a refugee protection claim has been withdrawn or abandoned;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: a decision of the Refugee Protection Division rejecting a claim for refugee protection that states that the claim has no credible basis or is manifestly unfounded;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: subject to the regulations, a decision of the Refugee Protection Division in respect of a claim for refugee protection if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: the foreign national who makes the claim came directly or indirectly to Canada from a country that is, on the day on which their claim is made, designated by regulations made under subsection 102(1) and that is a party to an agreement referred to in paragraph 102(2)(d), and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: the claim — by virtue of regulations made under paragraph 102(1)(c) — is not ineligible under paragraph 101(1)(e) to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division;

label: (d.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: a decision of the Refugee Protection Division allowing or rejecting a claim for refugee protection made by a foreign national who is a national of a country that was, on the day on which the decision was made, a country designated under subsection 109.1(1);

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: a decision of the Refugee Protection Division allowing or rejecting an application by the Minister for a determination that refugee protection has ceased;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: a decision of the Refugee Protection Division allowing or rejecting an application by the Minister to vacate a decision to allow a claim for refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: The appeal must be filed and perfected within the time limits set out in the regulations.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: Subject to subsections (3.1), (4) and (6), the Refugee Appeal Division must proceed without a hearing, on the basis of the record of the proceedings of the Refugee Protection Division, and may accept documentary evidence and written submissions from the Minister and the person who is the subject of the appeal and, in the case of a matter that is conducted before a panel of three members, written submissions from a representative or agent of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees and any other person described in the rules of the Board.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: Unless a hearing is held under subsection (6), the Refugee Appeal Division must make a decision within the time limits set out in the regulations.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: On appeal, the person who is the subject of the appeal may present only evidence that arose after the rejection of their claim or that was not reasonably available, or that the person could not reasonably have been expected in the circumstances to have presented, at the time of the rejection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: Subsection (4) does not apply in respect of evidence that is presented in response to evidence presented by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: The Refugee Appeal Division may hold a hearing if, in its opinion, there is documentary evidence referred to in subsection (3)

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: that raises a serious issue with respect to the credibility of the person who is the subject of the appeal;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: that is central to the decision with respect to the refugee protection claim; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: that, if accepted, would justify allowing or rejecting the refugee protection claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: After considering the appeal, the Refugee Appeal Division shall make one of the following decisions:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: confirm the determination of the Refugee Protection Division;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: set aside the determination and substitute a determination that, in its opinion, should have been made; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: refer the matter to the Refugee Protection Division for re-determination, giving the directions to the Refugee Protection Division that it considers appropriate.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: [Repealed, 2012, c. 17, s. 37]

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: The Refugee Appeal Division may make the referral described in paragraph (1)(c) only if it is of the opinion that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: the decision of the Refugee Protection Division is wrong in law, in fact or in mixed law and fact; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: it cannot make a decision under paragraph (1)(a) or (b) without hearing evidence that was presented to the Refugee Protection Division.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Appeal to Refugee Appeal Division
own_text: If the Refugee Appeal Division confirms a decision of the Refugee Protection Division to reject a claim for refugee protection, the decision of the Refugee Appeal Division is itself a decision to reject the claim.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this Division, and may include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: time limits for the provision of documents and information under subsection 99(3.1) or 100(4);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: time limits for the hearing referred to in subsection 100(4.1);

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: exceptions to the application of paragraph 101(1)(b.1);

label: (b.2)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: exceptions to the application of paragraph 101(1)(b.2);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: exceptions to the application of paragraph 110(2)(d);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: time limits for the filing and perfecting of an appeal under subsection 110(2.1); and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
own_text: time limits for the making of a decision by the Refugee Appeal Division, the extension of those time limits and the circumstances in which they do not apply.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 2 Convention Refugees and Persons in Need of Protection > Regulations
