own_text: With respect to claimants who are nationals of a country that is, on the day on which their claim is made, a country designated under subsection 109.1(1), regulations made under paragraph (1)(b) may provide for time limits that are different from the time limits for other claimants.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: A person in Canada, other than a person referred to in subsection 115(1), may, in accordance with the regulations, apply to the Minister for protection if they are subject to a removal order that is in force or are named in a certificate described in subsection 77(1).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: Despite subsection (1), a person may not apply for protection if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: they are the subject of an authority to proceed issued under section 15 of the Extradition Act ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: they have made a claim to refugee protection that has been determined under paragraph 101(1)(e) to be ineligible;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: subject to subsection (2.1), less than 12 months, or, in the case of a person who is a national of a country that is designated under subsection 109.1(1), less than 36 months, have passed since

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which their claim for refugee protection was rejected — unless it was deemed to be rejected under subsection 109(3) or was rejected on the basis of section E or F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention — or determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the Refugee Protection Division, in the case where no appeal was made and no application was made to the Federal Court for leave to commence an application for judicial review, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in any other case, the latest of

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which their claim for refugee protection was rejected — unless it was deemed to be rejected under subsection 109(3) or was rejected on the basis of section E or F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention — or determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the Refugee Protection Division or, if there was more than one such rejection or determination, the day on which the last one occurred,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which their claim for refugee protection was rejected — unless it was rejected on the basis of section E or F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention — or determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the Refugee Appeal Division or, if there was more than one such rejection or determination, the day on which the last one occurred, and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which the Federal Court refused their application for leave to commence an application for judicial review, or denied their application for judicial review, with respect to their claim for refugee protection, unless that claim was deemed to be rejected under subsection 109(3) or was rejected on the basis of section E or F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: subject to subsection (2.1), less than 12 months, or, in the case of a person who is a national of a country that is designated under subsection 109.1(1), less than 36 months, have passed since

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which their application for protection was rejected or determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the Minister, in the case where no application was made to the Federal Court for leave to commence an application for judicial review, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in any other case, the later of

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which their application for protection was rejected or determined to be withdrawn or abandoned by the Minister or, if there was more than one such rejection or determination, the day on which the last one occurred, and

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the day on which the Federal Court refused their application for leave to commence an application for judicial review, or denied their application for judicial review, with respect to their application for protection.

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: [Repealed, 2012, c. 17, s. 38]

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: The Minister may exempt from the application of paragraph (2)(b.1) or (c)

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the nationals — or, in the case of persons who do not have a country of nationality, the former habitual residents — of a country;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: the nationals or former habitual residents of a country who, before they left the country, lived in a given part of that country; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: a class of nationals or former habitual residents of a country.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: However, an exemption made under subsection (2.1) does not apply to persons in respect of whom, after the day on which the exemption comes into force, a decision is made respecting their claim for refugee protection by the Refugee Protection Division or, if an appeal is made, by the Refugee Appeal Division.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: The regulations may govern any matter relating to the application of subsection (2.1) or (2.2) and may include provisions establishing the criteria to be considered when an exemption is made.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: Refugee protection may not be conferred on an applicant who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: is determined to be inadmissible on grounds of security, violating human or international rights or organized criminality;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: is determined to be inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality with respect to a conviction in Canada of an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years or with respect to a conviction outside Canada for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: made a claim to refugee protection that was rejected on the basis of section F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: is named in a certificate referred to in subsection 77(1).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: Consideration of an application for protection shall be as follows:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: an applicant whose claim to refugee protection has been rejected may present only new evidence that arose after the rejection or was not reasonably available, or that the applicant could not reasonably have been expected in the circumstances to have presented, at the time of the rejection;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: a hearing may be held if the Minister, on the basis of prescribed factors, is of the opinion that a hearing is required;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of an applicant not described in subsection 112(3), consideration shall be on the basis of sections 96 to 98;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of an applicant described in subsection 112(3) — other than one described in subparagraph (e)(i) or (ii) — consideration shall be on the basis of the factors set out in section 97 and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of an applicant for protection who is inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality, whether they are a danger to the public in Canada, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of any other applicant, whether the application should be refused because of the nature and severity of acts committed by the applicant or because of the danger that the applicant constitutes to the security of Canada; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of the following applicants, consideration shall be on the basis of sections 96 to 98 and subparagraph (d)(i) or (ii), as the case may be:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: an applicant who is determined to be inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality with respect to a conviction in Canada of an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years for which a term of imprisonment of less than two years — or no term of imprisonment — was imposed, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: an applicant who is determined to be inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality with respect to a conviction of an offence outside Canada that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years, unless they are found to be a person referred to in section F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: Unless the application is allowed without a hearing, a hearing must, despite paragraph 113(b), be held in the case of an applicant for protection whose claim for refugee protection has been determined to be ineligible solely under paragraph 101(1)(c.1).

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: A decision to allow the application for protection has

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of an applicant not described in subsection 112(3), the effect of conferring refugee protection; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: in the case of an applicant described in subsection 112(3), the effect of staying the removal order with respect to a country or place in respect of which the applicant was determined to be in need of protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: If the Minister is of the opinion that the circumstances surrounding a stay of the enforcement of a removal order have changed, the Minister may re-examine, in accordance with paragraph 113(d) and the regulations, the grounds on which the application was allowed and may cancel the stay.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: If the Minister is of the opinion that a decision to allow an application for protection was obtained as a result of directly or indirectly misrepresenting or withholding material facts on a relevant matter, the Minister may vacate the decision.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Protection
own_text: If a decision is vacated under subsection (3), it is nullified and the application for protection is deemed to have been rejected.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
own_text: A protected person or a person who is recognized as a Convention refugee by another country to which the person may be returned shall not be removed from Canada to a country where they would be at risk of persecution for reasons of race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group or political opinion or at risk of torture or cruel and unusual treatment or punishment.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply in the case of a person

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
own_text: who is inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality and who constitutes, in the opinion of the Minister, a danger to the public in Canada; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
own_text: who is inadmissible on grounds of security, violating human or international rights or organized criminality if, in the opinion of the Minister, the person should not be allowed to remain in Canada on the basis of the nature and severity of acts committed or of danger to the security of Canada.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
own_text: A person, after a determination under paragraph 101(1)(e) that the person’s claim is ineligible, is to be sent to the country from which the person came to Canada, but may be sent to another country if that country is designated under subsection 102(1) or if the country from which the person came to Canada has rejected their claim for refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 2 Refugee Protection > DIVISION 3 Pre-removal Risk Assessment > Principle of Non-refoulement
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this Division, and may include provisions respecting procedures to be followed with respect to applications for protection and decisions made under section 115, including the establishment of factors to determine whether a hearing is required.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: No person shall organize, induce, aid or abet the coming into Canada of one or more persons knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, their coming into Canada is or would be in contravention of this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: A person who contravenes subsection (1) with respect to fewer than 10 persons is guilty of an offence and liable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: on conviction on indictment

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: for a first offence, to a fine of not more than $500,000 or to a term of imprisonment of not more than 10 years, or to both, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: for a subsequent offence, to a fine of not more than $1,000,000 or to a term of imprisonment of not more than 14 years, or to both; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $100,000 or to a term of imprisonment of not more than two years, or to both.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: A person who contravenes subsection (1) with respect to a group of 10 persons or more is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction by way of indictment to a fine of not more than $1,000,000 or to life imprisonment, or to both.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: A person who is convicted on indictment of an offence under subsection (2) or (3) with respect to fewer than 50 persons is also liable to a minimum punishment of imprisonment for a term of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: three years, if either

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the person, in committing the offence, endangered the life or safety of, or caused bodily harm or death to, any of the persons with respect to whom the offence was committed, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the commission of the offence was for profit, or was for the benefit of, at the direction of or in association with a criminal organization or terrorist group; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: five years, if both

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the person, in committing the offence, endangered the life or safety of, or caused bodily harm or death to, any of the persons with respect to whom the offence was committed, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the commission of the offence was for profit, or was for the benefit of, at the direction of or in association with a criminal organization or terrorist group.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: A person who is convicted of an offence under subsection (3) with respect to a group of 50 persons or more is also liable to a minimum punishment of imprisonment for a term of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: five years, if either

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the person, in committing the offence, endangered the life or safety of, or caused bodily harm or death to, any of the persons with respect to whom the offence was committed, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the commission of the offence was for profit, or was for the benefit of, at the direction of or in association with a criminal organization or terrorist group; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: 10 years, if both

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the person, in committing the offence, endangered the life or safety of, or caused bodily harm or death to, any of the persons with respect to whom the offence was committed, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the commission of the offence was for profit, or was for the benefit of, at the direction of or in association with a criminal organization or terrorist group.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: No proceedings for an offence under this section may be instituted except by or with the consent of the Attorney General of Canada.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: No person shall knowingly organize the coming into Canada of one or more persons by means of abduction, fraud, deception or use or threat of force or coercion.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: For the purpose of subsection (1), organize , with respect to persons, includes their recruitment or transportation and, after their entry into Canada, the receipt or harbouring of those persons.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: A person shall not disembark a person or group of persons at sea for the purpose of inducing, aiding or abetting them to come into Canada in contravention of this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: A person who contravenes section 118 or 119 is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction by way of indictment to a fine of not more than $1,000,000 or to life imprisonment, or to both.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: The court, in determining the penalty to be imposed under section 120, shall take into account whether

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: bodily harm or death occurred, or the life or safety of any person was endangered, as a result of the commission of the offence;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the commission of the offence was for the benefit of, at the direction of or in association with a criminal organization;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: the commission of the offence was for profit, whether or not any profit was realized; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: a person was subjected to humiliating or degrading treatment, including with respect to work or health conditions or sexual exploitation as a result of the commission of the offence.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: For the purposes of subparagraphs 117(3.1)(a)(ii) and (b)(ii) and (3.2)(a)(ii) and (b)(ii) and paragraph 121(b), criminal organization means a criminal organization as defined in subsection 467.1(1) of the Criminal Code .

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Human Smuggling and Trafficking
own_text: For the purposes of subparagraphs 117(3.1)(a)(ii) and (b)(ii) and (3.2)(a)(ii) and (b)(ii), terrorist group means a terrorist group as defined in subsection 83.01(1) of the Criminal Code .

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: No person shall, in order to contravene this Act,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: possess a passport, visa or other document, of Canadian or foreign origin, that purports to establish or that could be used to establish a person’s identity;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: use such a document, including for the purpose of entering or remaining in Canada; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: import, export or deal in such a document.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: Proof of the matters referred to in subsection (1) in relation to a forged document or a document that is blank, incomplete, altered or not genuine is, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, proof that the person intends to contravene this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: Every person who contravenes

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: paragraph 122(1)(a) is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction on indictment to a term of imprisonment of up to five years; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: paragraph 122(1)(b) or (c) is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction on indictment to a term of imprisonment of up to 14 years.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: The court, in determining the penalty to be imposed, shall take into account whether

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: the commission of the offence was for the benefit of, at the direction of or in association with a criminal organization as defined in subsection 121.1(1); and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Offences Related to Documents
own_text: the commission of the offence was for profit, whether or not any profit was realized.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: Every person commits an offence who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: contravenes a provision of this Act for which a penalty is not specifically provided or fails to comply with a condition or obligation imposed under this Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: escapes or attempts to escape from lawful custody or detention under this Act; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: employs a foreign national in a capacity in which the foreign national is not authorized under this Act to be employed.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(c), a person who fails to exercise due diligence to determine whether employment is authorized under this Act is deemed to know that it is not authorized.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: A person referred to in subsection 148(1) shall not be found guilty of an offence under paragraph (1)(a) if it is established that they exercised all due diligence to prevent the commission of the offence.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: A person who commits an offence under subsection 124(1) is liable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $50,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than two years, or to both; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $10,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than six months, or to both.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: Every person who knowingly counsels, induces, aids or abets or attempts to counsel, induce, aid or abet any person to directly or indirectly misrepresent or withhold material facts relating to a relevant matter that induces or could induce an error in the administration of this Act is guilty of an offence.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: No person shall knowingly

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: directly or indirectly misrepresent or withhold material facts relating to a relevant matter that induces or could induce an error in the administration of this Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: communicate, directly or indirectly, by any means, false or misleading information or declarations with intent to induce or deter immigration to Canada; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: refuse to be sworn or to affirm or declare, as the case may be, or to answer a question put to the person at an examination or at a proceeding held under this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: A person who contravenes a provision of section 126 or 127 is guilty of an offence and liable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $100,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than five years, or to both; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $50,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than two years, or to both.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: Every person is guilty of an offence who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: being an officer or an employee of the Government of Canada, knowingly makes or issues any false document or statement, or accepts or agrees to accept a bribe or other benefit, in respect of any matter under this Act or knowingly fails to perform their duties under this Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: gives or offers to give a bribe or consideration to, or makes an agreement or arrangement with, an officer to induce the officer not to perform their duties under this Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: falsely personates an officer or by any act or omission leads any person to believe that the person is an officer; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: obstructs or impedes an officer in the performance of the officer’s duties under this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: Every person who is guilty of an offence under subsection (1) is liable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: on conviction on indictment, to a fine of not more than $50,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than five years, or to both; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: on summary conviction, to a fine of not more than $10,000 or to imprisonment for a term of not more than six months, or to both.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: [Repealed, 2001, c. 32, s. 81]

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: Every person who knowingly induces, aids or abets or attempts to induce, aid or abet any person to contravene section 117, 118, 119, 122, 124 or 129, or who counsels a person to do so, commits an offence and is liable to the same penalty as that person.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > General Offences
own_text: [Repealed, 2001, c. 32, s. 81]

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: A person who has claimed refugee protection, and who came to Canada directly or indirectly from the country in respect of which the claim is made, may not be charged with an offence under section 122, paragraph 124(1)(a) or section 127 of this Act or under section 57, paragraph 340(c) or section 354, 366, 368, 374 or 403 of the Criminal Code , in relation to the coming into Canada of the person, pending disposition of their claim for refugee protection or if refugee protection is conferred.

marginal_note: Limitation period for summary conviction offences
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences

marginal_note: Limitation period for summary conviction offences
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: A proceeding by way of summary conviction for an offence under section 117, 126 or 127, or section 131 as it relates to section 117, may be instituted at any time within, but not later than, 10 years after the day on which the subject-matter of the proceeding arose, and a proceeding by way of summary conviction for any other offence under this Act may be instituted at any time within, but not later than, five years after the day on which the subject-matter of the proceeding arose.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply if the subject-matter of the proceeding arose before the day on which this section comes into force.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: No person may be found guilty of an offence or subjected to a penalty for the contravention of a provision of a regulation that incorporates material by reference, unless it is proved that, at the time of the alleged contravention,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: the material was reasonably accessible to the person;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: reasonable steps had been taken to ensure that the material was accessible to persons likely to be affected by the regulation; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: the material had been published in the Canada Gazette .

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: An act or omission that would by reason of this Act be punishable as an offence if committed in Canada is, if committed outside Canada, an offence under this Act and may be tried and punished in Canada.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: A proceeding in respect of an offence under this Act may be instituted, tried and determined at the place in Canada where the offence was committed or at the place in Canada where the person charged with the offence is or has an office or place of business at the time of the institution of those proceedings.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Prosecution of Offences
own_text: A proceeding in respect of an offence under this Act that is committed outside Canada may be instituted, tried and determined at any place in Canada.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Forfeiture
PART 3 Enforcement > Forfeiture
own_text: A court that convicts a person of an offence under this Act may, in addition to any other punishment imposed, order that any offence-related property seized in relation to the offence be forfeited to Her Majesty in right of Canada.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Forfeiture
own_text: The regulations may define the expression “offence-related property” for the purposes of this section, may provide for any matter relating to the application of this section, and may include provisions respecting the return to their lawful owner, disposition, or disposition of the proceeds of disposition, of offence-related property that has been seized.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: An officer, if so authorized, has the authority and powers of a peace officer — including those set out in sections 487 to 492.2 of the Criminal Code — to enforce this Act, including any of its provisions with respect to the arrest, detention or removal from Canada of any person.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: An officer may, in cases of emergency, employ a person to assist the officer in carrying out duties under this Act. That person has the authority and powers of the officer for a period of no more than 48 hours, unless approved by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: An officer may search any person seeking to come into Canada and may search their luggage and personal effects and the means of transportation that conveyed the person to Canada if the officer believes on reasonable grounds that the person

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: has not revealed their identity or has hidden on or about their person documents that are relevant to their admissibility; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: has committed, or possesses documents that may be used in the commission of, an offence referred to in section 117, 118 or 122.

marginal_note: Search by person of same sex
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: A search of a person under this section must be performed by a person of the same sex as the person being searched. If an officer of the same sex is not available, any suitable person of the same sex may be authorized by an officer to perform the search.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: An officer may seize and hold any means of transportation, document or other thing if the officer believes on reasonable grounds that it was fraudulently or improperly obtained or used or that the seizure is necessary to prevent its fraudulent or improper use or to carry out the purposes of this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: Despite subsection 42(2) of the Canada Post Corporation Act , a thing or document that is detained under the Customs Act and seized by an officer is not in the course of post for the purposes of the Canada Post Corporation Act .

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this section and may include provisions respecting the deposit of security as a guarantee to replace things that have been seized or that might otherwise be seized, and the return to their lawful owner, and the disposition, of things that have been seized.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Officers Authorized to Enforce Act
own_text: Every officer has the authority to administer oaths and to take and receive evidence under oath on any matter arising out of this Act.

marginal_note: Duties of peace officers to execute orders
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers

marginal_note: Duties of peace officers to execute orders
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: Every peace officer and every person in immediate charge or control of an immigrant station shall, when so directed by an officer, execute any warrant or written order issued under this Act for the arrest, detention or removal from Canada of any permanent resident or foreign national.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: In this section, immigrant station means, subject to subsection (3), a facility that is operated by the Canada Border Services Agency — or used by a peace officer or any party to an agreement or arrangement entered into under paragraph 13(2)(b) of the Canada Border Services Agency Act — for the purpose of detaining persons under this Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: An area of a penitentiary , as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Corrections and Conditional Release Act , may be an immigrant station only if it is designated under subsection 94.4(1) of that Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: A person detained under this Act must not be detained in a designated immigrant station , as defined in section 94.1 of the Corrections and Conditional Release Act , unless, subject to subsections (5) to (7), the Minister determines that the person is to be detained in a designated immigrant station because the person requires a high degree of supervision and control, based on

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: the nature and level of the danger to the public that the person poses, having regard to any of the following factors:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: any conviction in Canada under an Act of Parliament for a sexual offence or an offence involving violence or weapons,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: any conviction outside Canada for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute a sexual offence or an offence involving violence or weapons under an Act of Parliament,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: any pending charges in Canada under an Act of Parliament for a sexual offence or an offence involving violence or weapons,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: any pending charges outside Canada, for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute a sexual offence or an offence involving violence or weapons under an Act of Parliament,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: association with a criminal organization , within the meaning of subsection 121.1(1), or

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: association with an organization that engages, or has engaged, in terrorism; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: any serious non-compliance by the person with the rules, applicable in an immigrant station, any other detention facility or any correctional facility where the person is or has been detained, with respect to

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: the possession of weapons or the possession of or dealing in controlled substances , as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act , or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: violent or aggressive behaviour towards any other person.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: The Minister must not determine that a minor child detained under this Act is to be detained in a designated immigrant station.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: Before determining that a person detained under this Act is to be detained in a designated immigrant station, the Minister must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: provide the person with a written notice informing them that the Minister is considering making a determination that the person is to be detained in a designated immigrant station and informing them of the right to make submissions and to retain and instruct counsel;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: allow the person a reasonable opportunity to exercise the rights referred in paragraph (a); and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: consider the person’s state of health and health care needs, including with respect to their mental health.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: If the Minister determines that a person detained under this Act is to be detained in a designated immigrant station, the Minister must provide the person with written reasons for the determination before the person is detained in a designated immigrant station.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: Subsections (6) and (7) do not apply in an emergency in which a person detained under the Act must be immediately detained in a designated immigrant station because of a risk to the safety of the person or to other persons in, or a risk to the security of, the immigrant station where the person is or would otherwise be detained.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: If a person is detained in a designated immigrant station in the circumstances described in subsection (8), the Minister must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: as soon as feasible after the person is detained in the designated immigrant station, provide the person with a written notice informing them that the Minister is considering making a determination that the person is to remain detained in a designated immigrant station and informing them of the right to make submissions and to retain and instruct counsel; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: allow the person a reasonable opportunity to exercise the rights referred in paragraph (a).

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: If the Minister determines that a person detained in a designated immigrant station in the circumstances described in subsection (8) is to remain detained in the designated immigrant station, the Minister must provide the person with written reasons for the determination.

marginal_note: Authority to execute warrants and orders
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Peace Officers
own_text: A warrant issued or an order to detain made under this Act is, notwithstanding any other law, sufficient authority to the person to whom it is addressed or who may receive and execute it to arrest and detain the person with respect to whom the warrant or order was issued or made.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: In addition to other procedures set out in this Act or in the Criminal Code for commencing a proceeding, proceedings in respect of any prescribed offence may be commenced in accordance with this section.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: An officer may commence a proceeding by

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: completing a ticket that consists of a summons portion and an information portion;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: delivering the summons portion of the ticket to the accused or mailing it to the accused at the accused’s latest known address; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: filing the information portion of the ticket with a court of competent jurisdiction before or as soon as practicable after the summons portion has been delivered or mailed.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: The summons and information portions of a ticket must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: set out a description of the offence and the time and place of its alleged commission;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: include a statement, signed by the officer, that there are reasonable grounds to believe that the accused committed the offence;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: set out the amount of the prescribed fine for the offence and the manner in which and period within which it must be paid;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: include a statement that, if the accused pays the fine within the period set out in the ticket, a conviction will be entered and recorded against the accused; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: include a statement that if the accused wishes to plead not guilty or for any other reason fails to pay the fine within the period set out in the ticket, the accused must appear in the court and at the time set out in the ticket.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: Payment of the fine by the accused within the period set out in the ticket constitutes a plea of guilty to the offence described in the ticket and, following the payment,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: a conviction shall be entered against the accused and no further action shall be taken against the accused in respect of that offence; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: any thing seized from the accused under this Act relating to the offence described in the ticket, or any proceeds realized from its disposition, are forfeited to Her Majesty in right of Canada and may be disposed of as the Minister directs.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this section, and may include provisions prescribing

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: the offences referred to in subsection (1) and the manner in which those offences may be described in tickets; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Ticketable Offences
own_text: the amount of the fine, not exceeding $10,000, for a prescribed offence.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: The following amounts are debts due to Her Majesty in right of Canada payable on demand:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: a debt incurred by Her Majesty for which any person is liable under this Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: an amount that a person has agreed to pay as a deposit or guarantee of performance of an obligation under this Act;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: the amount of a penalty imposed under any regulation made under paragraph 32(d.4);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: the costs incurred in removing a prescribed foreign national from Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: an amount that is ordered to be paid under section 147 on account of an unpaid liability; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: an amount referred to in paragraph 148(1)(g).

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: Subject to any federal-provincial agreement, an amount that a sponsor is required to pay under the terms of an undertaking is payable on demand to Her Majesty in right of Canada and Her Majesty in right of the province concerned and may be recovered by Her Majesty in either or both of those rights.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Debt Due to Her Majesty
own_text: A debt may be recovered at any time.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: An amount or part of an amount payable under this Act that has not been paid may be certified by the Minister

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: without delay, if the Minister is of the opinion that the person liable for that amount is attempting to avoid payment; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: in any other case, on the expiration of 30 days after the default.

marginal_note: Minister of Employment and Social Development
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: When a penalty is imposed as a result of the Minister of Employment and Social Development exercising a power conferred on him or her by regulation made under paragraph 32(d.4), that Minister is responsible for the recovery of the debt referred to in paragraph 145(1)(b.1).

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: The certificate is to be filed and registered in the Federal Court and, when registered, has the same force and effect, and all proceedings may be taken, as if the certificate were a judgment obtained in the Court for a debt of the amount specified in the certificate plus interest to the day of payment.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: The costs of registering the certificate are recoverable in the same manner as if they had been included in the certificate.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: If the Minister is of the opinion that a person is or is about to become liable to make a payment to a person liable to make a payment under this Act, the Minister may, by written notice, order the first person to pay to the Receiver General, on account of the second person’s liability, all or part of the money otherwise payable to the second person.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: If the Minister, under subsection (1), orders an employer to pay to the Receiver General money otherwise payable to an employee as remuneration,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: the order is applicable to all future payments of remuneration until the liability is satisfied; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: the employer shall pay to the Receiver General out of each payment of remuneration the amount that the Minister stipulates in the notice.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: The receipt of the Minister is a good and sufficient discharge of the original liability to the extent of the payment.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Collection of Debts Due to Her Majesty
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the application of this section.

marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies

marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: A person who owns or operates a vehicle or a transportation facility, and an agent for such a person, must, in accordance with the regulations,

label: (a)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: not carry to Canada a person who is prescribed or does not hold a prescribed document, or whom an officer directs not to be carried;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: hold the prescribed documentation of a person whom it carries to Canada until an examination begins, present the person for examination and hold the person until the examination is completed;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: arrange for a medical examination and medical treatment and observation of a person it carries to Canada;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: provide prescribed information, including documentation and reports;

label: (e)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: provide facilities for the holding and examination of persons being carried to Canada;

label: (f)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: carry from Canada a person whom it has carried to or caused to enter Canada and who is prescribed or whom an officer directs to be carried;

label: (g)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: pay for all prescribed costs and fees relating to paragraphs (a), (b), (c) and (f); and

label: (h)
marginal_note: Obligation of operators of vehicles and facilities
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: provide security for compliance with its obligations under paragraphs (a) to (g).

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: If a person who owns or operates a vehicle or a transportation facility, or an agent of such a person, fails to comply with an obligation under this Act, all or part of any security provided by the person and any vehicle or other prescribed good owned or operated by the person may be detained, seized or forfeited to Her Majesty in right of Canada.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: The following provisions govern information provided under paragraph 148(1)(d):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: the information may be used only for the purposes of this Act or the Department of Citizenship and Immigration Act or to identify a person for whom a warrant of arrest has been issued in Canada; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: notice regarding use of the information must be given to the person to whom it relates.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to the purposes of sections 148 and 149, may define, for the purposes of this Act, terms used in those sections and may include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: the requirements and procedures applicable to a person who owns or operates a vehicle or a transportation facility;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: the costs and fees for which a person who owns or operates a vehicle or a transportation facility is liable;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: the procedures to be followed when a vehicle or other security is detained, seized, forfeited to Her Majesty in right of Canada or returned; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Transportation Companies
own_text: the procedures by which a person may make claim that their interest in a vehicle or other good is not affected by it being detained, seized or forfeited to Her Majesty in right of Canada.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: The regulations may provide for any matter relating to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: the collection, retention, use, disclosure and disposal of information, including a Social Insurance Number, for the purposes of this Act or for the purposes of program legislation as defined in section 2 of the Canada Border Services Agency Act ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: the disclosure of information for the purposes of national security, the defence of Canada or the conduct of international affairs, including the implementation of an agreement or arrangement entered into under section 5 or 5.1 of the Department of Citizenship and Immigration Act or section 13 of the Canada Border Services Agency Act ;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: the disclosure of information relating to the professional or ethical conduct of a person referred to in any of paragraphs 91(2)(a) to (c) in connection with a proceeding — other than a proceeding before a superior court — or application under this Act to a body that is responsible for governing or investigating that conduct or to a person who is responsible for investigating that conduct, for the purposes of ensuring that persons referred to in those paragraphs offer and provide professional and ethical representation and advice to persons in connection with such proceedings and applications;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: the retention, use, disclosure and disposal by the Royal Canadian Mounted Police of biometric information and any related personal information that is collected under this Act and provided to it for the enforcement of any law of Canada or a province;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: the disclosure of information for the purposes of cooperation between the Government of Canada and the government of a province; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: the disclosure, for the purposes of cooperation, of information collected for the purposes of this Act to federal departments and agencies, including personal information disclosed under a written agreement or arrangement that includes the elements of personal information that may be disclosed, the purpose of disclosure, any limits on secondary use and subsequent transfer of personal information and any other relevant details.

heading_path: PART 3 Enforcement > Sharing of Information
own_text: Regulations made under subsection (1) may include conditions under which the collection, retention, use, disposal and disclosure may be made.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The Immigration and Refugee Board consists of the Refugee Protection Division, the Refugee Appeal Division, the Immigration Division and the Immigration Appeal Division.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The Board is composed of a Chairperson and other members as are required to ensure the proper functioning of the Board.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The Chairperson and other members of the Board must swear the oath or give the solemn affirmation of office set out in the rules of the Board.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The Chairperson and members of the Refugee Appeal Division and Immigration Appeal Division

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: are appointed to the Board by the Governor in Council, to hold office during good behaviour for a term not exceeding seven years, subject to removal by the Governor in Council at any time for cause, to serve in a regional or district office of the Board;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: [Repealed, 2010, c. 8, s. 18]

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: are eligible for reappointment in the same or another capacity;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: shall receive the remuneration that may be fixed by the Governor in Council;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: are entitled to be paid reasonable travel and living expenses incurred while absent in the course of their duties, in the case of a full-time member, from their ordinary place of work or, in the case of a part-time member, while absent from their ordinary place of residence;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: are deemed to be employed in the public service for the purposes of the Public Service Superannuation Act and in the federal public administration for the purposes of the Government Employees Compensation Act and any regulations made under section 9 of the Aeronautics Act ;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: may not accept or hold any office or employment or carry on any activity inconsistent with their duties and functions under this Act; and

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: if appointed as full-time members, must devote the whole of their time to the performance of their duties under this Act.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: [Repealed, 2012, c. 17, s. 84]

marginal_note: Deputy Chairperson and Assistant Deputy Chairpersons
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: One Deputy Chairperson for each Division referred to in subsection (1) and not more than 10 Assistant Deputy Chairpersons are to be designated by the Governor in Council from among the full-time members of those Divisions.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The Chairperson and the Deputy Chairpersons and Assistant Deputy Chairpersons of the Divisions referred to in subsection (1) are appointed on a full-time basis and the other members are appointed on a full-time or part-time basis.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The Deputy Chairperson of the Immigration Appeal Division and a majority of the Assistant Deputy Chairpersons of that Division and at least 10 per cent of the members of the Divisions referred to in subsection (1) must be members of at least five years standing at the bar of a province or notaries of at least five years standing at the Chambre des notaires du Québec .

marginal_note: Disposition after member ceases to hold office
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: A former member of the Board, within eight weeks after ceasing to be a member, may make or take part in a decision on a matter that they heard as a member, if the Chairperson so requests. For that purpose, the former member is deemed to be a member.

marginal_note: Disposition if member unable to take part
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: If a member of a three-member panel is unable to take part in the disposition of a matter that the member has heard, the remaining members may make the disposition and, for that purpose, are deemed to constitute the applicable Division.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: The following rules apply to the Chairperson and the members in respect of the exercise or purported exercise of their functions under this Act:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: no criminal or civil proceedings lie against them for anything done or omitted to be done in good faith; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Composition of Board
own_text: they are not competent or compellable to appear as a witness in any civil proceedings.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Head Office and Staff
PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Head Office and Staff
own_text: The head office of the Board shall be in the National Capital Region as described in the schedule to the National Capital Act .

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Head Office and Staff
own_text: The Chairperson must live in the National Capital Region or within reasonable commuting distance of it.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Head Office and Staff
own_text: The Executive Director and other personnel necessary for the proper conduct of the business of the Board shall be appointed in accordance with the Public Service Employment Act , and the personnel are deemed to be employed in the public service for the purposes of the Public Service Superannuation Act .

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: The Chairperson is, by virtue of holding that office, a member of each Division of the Board and is the chief executive officer of the Board. In that capacity, the Chairperson

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: has supervision over and direction of the work and staff of the Board;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: may at any time assign a member appointed under paragraph 153(1)(a) to the Refugee Appeal Division or the Immigration Appeal Division;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: may at any time, despite paragraph 153(1)(a), assign a member of the Refugee Appeal Division or the Immigration Appeal Division to work in another regional or district office to satisfy operational requirements, but an assignment may not exceed 120 days without the approval of the Governor in Council;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: may designate, from among the full-time members appointed under paragraph 153(1)(a), coordinating members for the Refugee Appeal Division or the Immigration Appeal Division;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: assigns administrative functions to the members of the Board;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: apportions work among the members of the Board and fixes the place, date and time of proceedings;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: takes any action that may be necessary to ensure that the members of the Board carry out their duties efficiently and without undue delay, including by specifying the manner in which decisions must be rendered and reasons for decisions must be given;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: may issue guidelines in writing to members of the Board and identify decisions of the Board as jurisprudential guides, after consulting with the Deputy Chairpersons, to assist members in carrying out their duties; and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: may appoint and, subject to the approval of the Treasury Board, fix the remuneration of experts or persons having special knowledge to assist the Divisions in any matter.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: The Chairperson may delegate any of his or her powers under this Act to a member of the Board, except that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: powers referred to in subsection 161(1) may not be delegated;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: powers referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) and (i) may be delegated to the Executive Director of the Board;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: powers in relation to the Immigration Appeal Division and the Refugee Appeal Division may only be delegated to the Deputy Chairperson, the Assistant Deputy Chairpersons, or other members, including coordinating members, of either of those Divisions; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: powers in relation to the Immigration Division or the Refugee Protection Division may only be delegated to the Deputy Chairperson, the Assistant Deputy Chairpersons or other members, including coordinating members, of that Division.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Duties of Chairperson
own_text: In the event of the absence or incapacity of the Chairperson, or if the office of Chairperson is vacant, the Minister may authorize one of the Deputy Chairpersons or any other member of the Board to act as Chairperson.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: Subject to the approval of the Governor in Council, and in consultation with the Deputy Chairpersons, the Chairperson may make rules respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: the referral of a claim for refugee protection to the Refugee Protection Division;

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: the factors to be taken into account in fixing or changing the date of the hearing referred to in subsection 100(4.1);

label: (a.2)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: the activities, practice and procedure of each of the Divisions of the Board, including the periods for appeal, other than in respect of appeals of decisions of the Refugee Protection Division, the priority to be given to proceedings, the notice that is required and the period in which notice must be given;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: the conduct of persons in proceedings before the Board, as well as the consequences of, and sanctions for, the breach of those rules;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: the information that may be required and the manner in which, and the time within which, it must be provided with respect to a proceeding before the Board; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: any other matter considered by the Chairperson to require rules.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: The rules made under paragraph (1)(c) may distinguish among claimants for refugee protection who make their claims inside Canada on the basis of whether their claims are made at a port of entry or elsewhere or on the basis of whether they are nationals of a country that is, on the day on which their claim is made, a country designated under subsection 109.1(1).

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Functioning of Board
own_text: The Minister shall cause a copy of any rule made under subsection (1) to be laid before each House of Parliament on any of the first 15 days on which that House is sitting after the approval of the rule by the Governor in Council.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: Each Division of the Board has, in respect of proceedings brought before it under this Act, sole and exclusive jurisdiction to hear and determine all questions of law and fact, including questions of jurisdiction.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: Each Division shall deal with all proceedings before it as informally and quickly as the circumstances and the considerations of fairness and natural justice permit.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: Matters before a Division shall be conducted before a single member unless, except for matters before the Immigration Division, the Chairperson is of the opinion that a panel of three members should be constituted.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: Where a hearing is held by a Division, it may, in the Division’s discretion, be conducted in the presence of, or by a means of live telecommunication with, the person who is the subject of the proceedings.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: The Refugee Protection Division, the Refugee Appeal Division and the Immigration Division and each member of those Divisions have the powers and authority of a commissioner appointed under Part I of the Inquiries Act and may do any other thing they consider necessary to provide a full and proper hearing.

heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: Proceedings before a Division are to be conducted as follows:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: subject to the other provisions of this section, proceedings must be held in public;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: on application or on its own initiative, the Division may conduct a proceeding in the absence of the public, or take any other measure that it considers necessary to ensure the confidentiality of the proceedings, if, after having considered all available alternate measures, the Division is satisfied that there is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: a serious possibility that the life, liberty or security of a person will be endangered if the proceeding is held in public,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: a real and substantial risk to the fairness of the proceeding such that the need to prevent disclosure outweighs the societal interest that the proceeding be conducted in public, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: a real and substantial risk that matters involving public security will be disclosed;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: subject to paragraph (d), proceedings before the Refugee Protection Division and the Refugee Appeal Division must be held in the absence of the public;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: subject to paragraph (d), proceedings before the Immigration Division must be held in the absence of the public if they concern a person who is the subject of a proceeding before the Refugee Protection Division or the Refugee Appeal Division that is pending or who has made an application for protection to the Minister that is pending;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: on application or on its own initiative, the Division may conduct a proceeding in public, or take any other measure that it considers necessary to ensure the appropriate access to the proceedings if, after having considered all available alternate measures and the factors set out in paragraph (b), the Division is satisfied that it is appropriate to do so;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
own_text: despite paragraphs (b) to (c.1), a representative or agent of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees is entitled to observe proceedings concerning a protected person or a person who has made a claim for refugee protection or an application for protection; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Immigration and Refugee Board > Provisions that Apply to All Divisions
